offers_products.reason: Sells packaged nutritional snacks and meal products under Atkins, Quest and OWYN brands.

offers_services.reason: Only makes and sells packaged foods; no services are offered to customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumer brands (Quest, Atkins) sold through grocery, club, mass and e-commerce; shoppers choose the brand.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Retailers like grocery, club and mass merchants buy its products for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Snack bars, shakes and chips are repeatedly bought consumables, reordered by retailers and shoppers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Low-cost packaged food staples; demand is relatively stable in downturns, though some trading down.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent purchases of snack bars, shakes and chips.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from packaged food products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main end buyers are households; retailers are large but the brand is consumer-focused.

asset_heavy.reason: Brand-led company relying on third-party co-manufacturers rather than owned plants or fleets.

notes: Large retail customers such as Walmart and Costco are significant, but the brands target consumers; the asset-light co-manufacturing model comes from prior knowledge.
